newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Xinjiang sets 2000 grain output target.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinjiang sets 2000 grain output target.

text.p: China's northwestern region of Xinjiang will strive to produce 8.5 million tonnes of grain by 2000, making it one of the country's major grain producers, Xinjiang Chairman Ablait Abdureschit said on Wednesday.
The region was expected to produce 7.8 million tonnes of grain in 1996.
Xinjiang hopes to produce 1.5 million tonnes of cotton by 2000, Abdureschit told a business summit in Beijing. The region's 1996 cotton output was forecast at 1.05 million tonnes.
Abdureschit said Xinjiang would aim to produce 25.0 million tonnes of crude oil and 4.0 billion cubic metres of natural gas by the turn of the century. He gave no comparative figures.
